시편 135:1.content: Praise ye the Lord. Praise ye the name of the Lord; praise him, O ye servants of the Lord.

시편 135:2.content: Ye that stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God,

시편 135:3.content: Praise the Lord; for the Lord is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.

시편 135:4.content: For the Lord hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.

시편 135:5.content: For I know that the Lord is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.

시편 135:6.content: Whatsoever the Lord pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.

시편 135:7.content: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.

시편 135:8.content: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.

시편 135:9.content: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.

시편 135:10.content: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;

시편 135:11.content: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:

시편 135:12.content: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.

시편 135:13.content: Thy name, O Lord, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O Lord, throughout all generations.

시편 135:14.content: For the Lord will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.

시편 135:15.content: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

시편 135:16.content: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;

시편 135:17.content: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.

시편 135:18.content: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.

시편 135:19.content: Bless the Lord, O house of Israel: bless the Lord, O house of Aaron:

시편 135:20.content: Bless the Lord, O house of Levi: ye that fear the Lord, bless the Lord.

시편 135:21.content: Blessed be the Lord out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.
